faq_heading: 1 bedroom condos in Langley: your questions answered

faq.q: What is the price of a 1 bedroom condo in Langley right now?
faq.a: Of the 1 bedroom condos in Langley, 195 sold over the past year at a median of $420,000, with the middle half between $380,000 and $453,000.

faq.q: Are 1 bedroom condos in Langley selling quickly?
faq.a: The median was 25 days, and homes sold for 97.3% of the list price at a median.

faq.q: Which parts of Langley sell the most 1 bedroom condos?
faq.a: Willoughby Heights, with 112 of the 195 sales at a median of $432,750.

faq.q: Which buildings in Langley have 1 bedroom condos for sale most often?
faq.a: By sales over the past year: The Hive 2 (19 sales, median $424,900); Elements (10 sales, median $400,000); The Commons (6 sales, median $436,500); Varsity (5 sales, median $310,000).

faq.q: What is the strata fee on a 1 bedroom condo in Langley?
faq.a: The median strata fee on the 1 bedroom condos that sold in Langley was $310 a month. Fees vary by building, so check the building's own figure.

blocks.text: How 1 bedroom condos in Langley compare
A 1 bedroom condo in Langley sold for $120,000 less at the median than a 2 bedroom one ($420,000 against $540,000, 441 sales). The strata fee was $310 a month against $433.
Of the 7 cities with 1 bedroom condo pages, Langley has the third highest median price. Abbotsford is lowest at $324,950 and South Surrey highest at $485,000.
